claim: Every variant example passes light and dark axe and colour audits through its generated Storybook page (9 pages), and the seven block browser tests pass in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.

behaviourRuns.run: account settings keep their editing, status, focus, and layout behavior in chromium
subtests: edits fields by keyboard and pointer, reports the status, restores on Cancel, and never submits
walks every control in order by accessible name, each with a focus ring that differs from rest
stacks the label column and fields below 40rem and sits them side by side from 40rem
never scrolls the page horizontally at 360, 768, and 1280 in light and dark

behaviourRuns.run: workspace navigation keeps its fold, menu, drawer, focus, and overflow behavior in chromium
subtests: shows the column beside the page from 40rem and a drawer header below it, with every href a fragment and a static current link
folds to an icon rail with the Toggle and unfolds, keeping every name and the header inside the rail
folds and unfolds with Cmd or Ctrl plus B, and leaves the chord to the Search field while typing
names every folded link in a tooltip on hover and keyboard focus
opens nested groups, and a folded group or Search unfolds the column
opens the workspace menu by pointer and keyboard, expanded and folded, and its items change nothing
keeps a visible outline on the workspace menu button in forced colors
keeps one keyboard order through the column and the page, with a visible focus ring in light and dark
opens a focus-trapping drawer below 40rem that returns focus to its button, even after the rail was folded
hands focus between the drawer and the column when the container crosses 40rem, closing the drawer as the column returns
never scrolls the page horizontally at 360, 768, and 1280 in light and dark, folded, unfolded, and in the drawer
